series.name: Evolving Nitro Badge
series.description: The Nitro profile badge changes design as an uninterrupted eligible Nitro subscription reaches milestones.
series.eligibility: Eligible Nitro subscriptions; Nitro Basic and Classic do not receive the evolving version.
series.reset_behavior: If the eligible subscription ends, progression resets when the user later resubscribes.

series.name: Server Booster Badge Evolution
series.description: The Server Booster profile badge evolves as an uninterrupted boosting streak reaches milestones.
series.eligibility: Maintain at least one active Server Boost.
series.reset_behavior: The streak resets if the user is no longer boosting any server.
